title: Tracing the Thoughts of a Coding Agent Playing ARC-AGI-3: Lessons for Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.11450v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how a coding agent learns across a sequence of abstract reasoning tasks. The agent runs on a frozen foundation model inside a fixed harness and acts by writing and running Python and shell scripts. It retains no state across turns other than its written artifacts, so every thought it forms, carries, corrects or abandons leaves a trace, where a thought is any belief, rule or plan committed to a file. We let the agent play ARC-AGI-3, a set of interactive reasoning games that provide no instructions. Each game is a sequence of levels, and a strategy that clears one level can fail on the next, so every new level is in effect a new task. The agent records what it learns as Python scripts and text notes, while the harness keeps a complete log of every action and observation. Our contribution is a measurement protocol that traces each thought through these files, from the task where it forms to the task where it is corrected or abandon

translated_title: 追踪编码智能体游玩ARC-AGI-3的思维轨迹：持续学习的启示
translated_abstract: 我们研究编码智能体如何在一系列抽象推理任务中进行学习。该智能体运行在冻结的基础模型上，处于固定的执行框架（harness）中，通过编写和运行Python及shell脚本来采取行动。除了其写入的文件产物之外，它在回合之间不保留任何状态，因此它形成、延续、修正或放弃的每一个想法都会留下痕迹，这里的一个想法是指任何被写入文件的信念、规则或计划。我们让该智能体游玩ARC-AGI-3，这是一组不提供任何说明的交互式推理游戏。每个游戏由一系列关卡组成，而通过某一关卡的策略可能在下一个关卡失效，因此每个新关卡实际上都是一个新任务。智能体将其学到的东西记录为Python脚本和文本笔记，同时执行框架完整地记录了每一个动作和观察的日志。我们的贡献是一种测量协议，能够追踪每个想法在这些文件中的完整轨迹，从它形成的任务到它被修正或放弃的任务。
tldr: 本文提出一种测量协议，通过追踪编码智能体写入文件中的所有想法（信念、规则、计划）从形成到修正或放弃的完整轨迹，来研究其在ARC-AGI-3无指令交互推理游戏中的持续学习过程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a measurement protocol that traces each thought of a coding agent—any belief, rule, or plan committed to files—from the task where it forms to where it is corrected or abandoned, studying continual learning across the instruction-free interactive reasoning games of ARC-AGI-3.
